name: partnexa-frontend
description: PartNexa Multi-App Frontend Aggregator for Vercel Deployment

scripts.build:customer: cd customer && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:admin: cd admin && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:delivery: cd delivery && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:shop: cd shop && npm install && npm run build
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build:customer && npm run build:admin && npm run build:delivery && npm run build:shop && npm run combine-dist
